label: GO after unrewarded a2->S2, stronger early in episode, after 2 losses, low value
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * value ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * choice ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * np.exp(-choice**2/4)
explanation: Sparse feature (nonzero on 1.1% of steps), active only at GO. Its magnitude is driven mainly by the previous trial being a2 -> S2 unrewarded (fitted weight about +0.31 at GO). It is larger when the trial before that was also unrewarded (+0.05), smaller later in the episode (-0.026 per episode decile), smaller when the model value is high (-0.011 per unit), and slightly larger when the policy logit leans toward a1 (+0.011 per unit). There is a smaller bump at GO after any unrewarded visit to S2 (including a1 S2 u) when the policy is undecided (exp(-choice^2/4) term, +0.06). Previous-trial patterns other than unrewarded S2 visits, the current choice/state, and the hidden good state add essentially nothing. It is silent at D1 and D2. Test R^2 beyond timing is 0.42, above the additive all ceiling of 0.30; the last-trial indicators alone reach about 0.32 on dev. It uses only observed cues plus the model value/policy, no future variables. Some large activations remain unexplained, for example on the window first trial where the history is unknown, and on some a1 choices after losses.
